stem:
A rectangular garden that is next to a building has a path around the other three sides, as shown.

[Image: Diagram of a garden and path next to a building]

What is the area of the path?
figure_description: A diagram shows a thick line labeled "Building" forming a vertical wall. Directly adjacent to the building wall is a shaded rectangular "Garden", surrounded on the remaining three sides by an unshaded "Path" forming a larger outer rectangle. The dimensions shown are: total vertical height of the outer rectangle along the building wall is 12 m; horizontal length of the garden is 10 m; vertical height of the garden is 8 m; and total horizontal width of the outer rectangle (garden plus path width) along the bottom is 12 m.
